Runs a shell script on the host
questions.answer: Opens an interactive shell as root inside the 'first' container
questions.explanation: lxc shell opens an interactive bash session as root inside the specified instance.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the `--` separator in `lxc exec first -- ls -la`?
options: It's optional syntax that does nothing
It separates lxc arguments from the command to run inside the instance
It tells lxc to run as a daemon
questions.answer: It separates lxc arguments from the command to run inside the instance
questions.explanation: The -- prevents flags like -la from being interpreted by lxc instead of the inner command.

questions.prompt: Which command runs `free -m` inside the 'first' container and returns the output?
questions.explanation: lxc exec <name> -- <command> runs a single command inside the instance.

questions.prompt: How do you exit an interactive shell opened with `lxc shell`?
questions.explanation: Type 'exit' to leave the interactive shell and return to your host terminal.
